# holynova · Where Craft Lives

> holynova 的个人作品集：收录游戏、AI 工具、创意视觉、开发工具与生活效率等上百个工程与设计项目——small ideas, better products。
>
> 作品集首页：https://xiaosang.cc/ ；源码：https://github.com/holynova

本文件列出作品集收录的全部公开项目，每个项目中英文各一句话介绍与演示链接，供 AI 助手索引与引用。

## Chrome 插件

- [X 书签回看](https://xiaosang.cc/x-bookmark-recall/): 自动导入 X 书签，在推荐和正在关注的时间线里重读旧收藏
  EN: Automatically imports X bookmarks and resurfaces them in For You and Following
- [prompt_one_by_one](https://xiaosang.cc/prompt-one-by-one/): Chrome 扩展：在 Gemini / AI 平台逐条批量执行提示词生成
  EN: Chrome extension for sequential batch prompt generation on Gemini and AI platforms
- [github-pages-detector-extension](https://xiaosang.cc/github-pages-detector-extension/): Chrome 扩展：自动检测当前 GitHub 仓库是否存在 Pages 在线预览
  EN: Chrome extension detecting active GitHub Pages for repositories automatically
- [json-workbench-extension](https://xiaosang.cc/json-workbench-extension/): 结构化 JSON 可视化编辑、语法校验与转换 Chrome 扩展
  EN: Chrome extension for structured JSON visual editing, validation, and conversion
- [scrape-to-markdown.chrome](https://xiaosang.cc/scrape-to-markdown-chrome/): Chrome 侧边栏扩展：一键提取网页为 Markdown、导出社交数据与媒体
  EN: Chrome side-panel extension to save web content as Markdown and export media
- [youtube-channel-scraper-chrome](https://youtube-channel-scraper-chrome.xiaosang.cc/): Chrome 扩展：自动滚动抓取 YouTube 频道视频信息并导出 JSON
  EN: Chrome extension to scrape YouTube channel video info with auto-scroll and JSON export
- [collection_miner](https://xiaosang.cc/collection-miner/): Chrome 新标签页智能唤醒与重温历史书签扩展
  EN: Chrome extension that resurfaces forgotten bookmarks on each new tab

## 纯内容网站

- [wujun-study](https://xiaosang.cc/wujun-study/): 吴军14门课程的42个学习专题，含17份15页中文漫画图解，支持全文搜索、原课追溯、全屏阅读与PDF下载
  EN: 42 thematic guides to 14 Wu Jun courses, with 17 reviewed Chinese comic slide decks of 15 pages each, full-text search, traceable sources and PDF downloads.
- [xiaosang AI图集](https://xiaosang.cc/xiaosang-gallery/): 汇集 22 个系列、3,666 张作品的统一图库，支持多图帖、分组搜索、沉浸滑览、单图下载和生成 Prompt。
  EN: A unified gallery of 3,666 images across 22 collections, with grouped posts, filters, full-screen swiping, downloads, and reusable prompts.
- [bernstein-ypc](https://xiaosang.cc/bernstein-ypc/): 伯恩斯坦《青少年音乐会》全 53 课导览：提炼核心观点与现场实验，支持全文搜索与分类筛选，附 B 站掘火中译视频与可折叠试听曲目单
  EN: Two-column study guide to all 53 Young People's Concerts with live search, category filters, Bilibili links, and playable repertoire previews.
- [x-prompt-library](https://xiaosang.cc/x-prompt-library/): Prompt 收藏册：27 组、71 条 AI 提示词，含原文、28 份中文译文、分类搜索与独立复制。
  EN: 71 AI prompts in 27 collections, with original text, 28 Chinese translations, category search and independent copy buttons.
- [concept-atlas](https://xiaosang.cc/concept-atlas/): 121张竖版知识漫画，一图解释熟悉术语背后的机制，支持分类、搜索与原图下载。
  EN: 121 illustrated explainers for familiar words with unfamiliar mechanics, with category filters, search and original PNG downloads.
- [world-unsolved-mysteries](https://holynova.github.io/world-unsolved-mysteries/): 世界未解之谜：80/90 后童年常听的 20 个谜题，集中展示辟谣结果与硬证据
  EN: World unsolved mysteries: 20 childhood mysteries from the 80s and 90s, with debunking verdicts and hard evidence
- [baking-variable-search](https://holynova.github.io/baking-variable-search/): 烘焙变量查询：60 种烘焙品多选组合搜索，选一个变量、其余计数实时联动
  EN: Baking variable search: faceted multi-select search across 60 bakes, with live counts that update as you pick
- [baking-encyclopedia](https://holynova.github.io/baking-encyclopedia/): 烘焙百科：用六个变量拆解 36 种烘焙品，讲清奇怪名字背后的逻辑
  EN: Baking encyclopedia: 36 bakes decoded through six variables, explaining the logic behind the odd names
- [rock-in-pictures](https://xiaosang.cc/rock-in-pictures/): 听见画面：60幅摄影意象猜华语乐队，点击即揭晓，支持线索与单张原图下载。
  EN: Sound in Sight: guess 60 Chinese bands from photographic riddles, with instant reveals, clues, and single-image downloads.
- [podcast-atlas](https://xiaosang.cc/podcast-atlas/): 播客图文知识库：两档播客分专题整理，支持关键词搜索，文字先读、中文漫画幻灯片逐步补齐
  EN: A podcast reading library with separate topic collections, keyword search, and articles published before illustrated Chinese slide decks.
- [《人生七年》时间线](https://xiaosang.cc/up-series-70years/): 记录《人生七年》14 位主角从 7 岁到 70 岁的 63 年人生轨迹：纪录片纪事、人物档案与横向变迁对比
  EN: Documentary archive tracing 14 lives across 63 years from age 7 to 70 with complete timelines and profiles
- [经典书导读 (112 本严选核实版)](https://xiaosang.cc/forty-classic-books/): 精选 8 大核心领域 112 本经典书严谨导读：章节严格对齐原书真实目录，总体观点、核心观点与全书结构剖析，拒绝虚假杜撰
  EN: Curated reading guides for 112 verified classic books across 8 domains with authentic chapter fidelity and real-world examples
- [帝号 · 皇帝称呼解码](https://dihao.xiaosang.cc/): 移动端皇帝称呼科普：16位人物、32条年号，图解姓名、庙号、谥号与尊号，支持对照、检索和小测验。
  EN: Mobile-first guide to imperial naming with 16 rulers, 32 era records, source-linked comparisons and quizzes.
- [半透明玩具兵](https://translucent-toy-guard.xiaosang.cc/): 20个卡通收藏玩具角色，以磨砂半透明甲壳、硬挺制服与鲜亮撞色展现各类卫士，支持分类、高清预览和分享。

  EN: Classic system design algorithms from Alex Xu's System Design Interview (28 chapters) implemented in vanilla JS, featuring SVG architecture diagrams, Mermaid workflows, and interactive playgrounds

  EN: System design workbook: hands-on KV replication, Snowflake IDs and URL shortening, with concept maps and recall exercises

## 创意视觉

- [pingye](https://xiaosang.cc/pingye/): 拼页：用九种版式制作个人海报、产品速览或城市导览，支持图片裁剪和高清 PNG 导出。
  EN: Make personal, product, and city posters with nine layouts, direct image cropping, and high-resolution PNG export.
- [photo-breakout](https://xiaosang.cc/photo-breakout/): 浏览器本地自动抠像，可调节横纵白色网格，支持多图历史、图文教程和 PNG 导出。
  EN: Create breakout photos with on-device portrait segmentation, adjustable white grids, a quick guide, local history, and PNG export.
- [纸间 · 折纸实验室](https://xiaosang.cc/origami-studio/): 五种经典折纸的三维动画，支持逐步播放、清晰折痕、纸色切换、展开图与 PNG 导出。
  EN: Explore five classic origami models in 3D with step playback, clear creases, paper colors, crease patterns and PNG export.
- [傅里叶地图实验室](https://xiaosang.cc/fourier-atlas/): 用旋转圆描绘地图与四神瓦当纹样，支持圆圈强调、纯净模式和渐进绘制。
  EN: Draw maps and Four Symbols tile motifs with Fourier epicycles, highlighted circles, a clean view and progressive detail.
- [玉石浮雕卡牌馆](https://xiaosang.cc/jade-cards-lab/): 四大主题 108 张精雕玉石扑克牌，Neo Kinpaku 黑漆金箔风格艺术展陈，支持 3D 翻转、沉浸大图品鉴与今日灵感抽牌
  EN: Kinpaku art edition of the Jade Relief Playing Card Gallery: 108 cards across four themes with 3D flip, fullscreen inspection, and oracle draw.
- [哆啦A梦的家 3D导览](https://xiaosang.cc/doraemon-house-3d/): 基于 Three.js 制作的野比大雄家 3D 立体空间导览：建筑外观、室内各层、空间拆解与点击交互
  EN: Interactive 3D walk-through of Nobita Nobi's house from Doraemon built with Three.js with exploded floor views
- [time-slider-clock](https://xiaosang.cc/time-slider-clock/): 镂空像素滑轨时钟：分列、整位、原作双轨与 5×5 字母滑轨，支持秒数、夜光主题和快进测试
  EN: Perforated-grid clock with column, whole-digit, original dual rails and a 5×5 perforated alphabet rails, seconds, neon themes and accelerated testing
- [cut_and_remix](https://xiaosang.cc/cut-and-remix/): 基于 Web 的数码照片编织与图像解构重组生成艺术工具
  EN: Web-based digital photo weaving and image deconstruction art tool
- [win98-screen-saver](https://xiaosang.cc/win98-screen-saver/): Windows 95/98 经典屏幕保护程序纯 Web 交互复刻
  EN: Web-based interactive reproduction of classic Windows 95/98 screen savers
- [kaleidoscope-studio](https://xiaosang.cc/kaleidoscope-studio/): 三角拖拽取样并实时平铺对称图案的万花筒生成器
  EN: Interactive kaleidoscope generator with draggable triangular sampling
- [card-3d-depth-lab](https://xiaosang.cc/card-3d-depth-lab/): 基于纯 CSS 打造的 3D 景深与指针视差悬浮卡片
  EN: Interactive CSS 3D card with parallax depth layers and pointer transforms
- [spinning-drawer](https://xiaosang.cc/spinning-drawer/): 基于圆、椭圆与多边形定子的电子螺旋绘图仪
  EN: Interactive spirograph curve generator with circular and polygonal stators
- [hand_fireworks](https://xiaosang.cc/hand-fireworks/): 基于手势识别的 Canvas 粒子烟花动画交互实验
  EN: Interactive Canvas particle fireworks animation triggered by gestures
- [raytracing-demo](https://xiaosang.cc/raytracing-demo/): 纯 Web 端的微型光线追踪（Ray Tracing）渲染演示
  EN: Pure Web micro raytracing renderer demonstration in JavaScript
- [string_alchemy](https://xiaosang.cc/string-alchemy/): 字符串格式转换、编解码与哈希计算工具箱
  EN: String transformations, encoding/decoding, and hash calculators
- [50-seeds](https://xiaosang.cc/50-seeds/): 24 个大类 × 50 组 AI 图像生成视觉 Seed 参数参考库
  EN: Reference library of 24 categories × 50 visual seed parameters for AI imagery

  EN: Music rhythm visualizer driven by audio envelope curve animations
- [sort_animation](https://xiaosang.cc/sort-animation/): 经典排序算法执行过程的可视化动态演示
  EN: Visual step-by-step animations of classic sorting algorithms

## AI 工具

- [Token Theater · 速度体验实验室](https://xiaosang.cc/token-theater/): 在手机、终端、网页和桌面界面并排体验大模型的输出速度、首字等待和流式节奏
  EN: Compare LLM streaming speed, first-token delay, and delivery cadence across mobile, terminal, web, and desktop interfaces.
- [医疗单据 OCR 工作台](https://hospital-ocr.xiaosang.cc/): 在浏览器本地识别医疗发票与病历，核对日期、金额和姓名，批量重命名并导出汇总表格
  EN: Browser-based medical receipt OCR: inspect dates, amounts, and names locally, batch rename files, and export summaries.
- [ask_all_ai](https://xiaosang.cc/ask-all-ai/): 多模型同屏对比：同时向 ChatGPT、Gemini、Grok 与 DeepSeek 提问
  EN: Side-by-side streaming comparison of ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, and DeepSeek responses
- [video_prompt_generator](https://video-prompt-generator.xiaosang.cc/): 基于参数模板的中英双语 AI 视频生成提示词构建工具
  EN: Bilingual AI video generation prompt builder using structured templates
